newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Huhtamaki 4-mth profit seen up.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Huhtamaki 4-mth profit seen up.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 125 million markka median forecast for Finnish confectionery and packaging group Huhtamaki Oy's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax.
(Profit forecasts by 13 analysts, EPS by five analysts).
Huhtamaki's four-month results are due on June 10 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-April 1996, Huhtamaki posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 108 million markka.
In March, Huhtamaki said the company's upward profit trend had been reinstated.
The median of 10 analysts' forecasts for Huhtamaki's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax was 591 million markka (mean 582 million) in a 509-635 million markka range.
In 1996, Huhtamaki's profit was 416 million markka.@

Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie Securities, Enskilda Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Merita Securities, Opstock Securities and Postipankki.
